description: SUPERHIGHWAY EXCLUSIVE ($399 / 5,000 Hashes): Data Integrity Audit, Instant Tamper Detection & Forensic Timechain Report (`GET /api/v1/account` + `GET /api/v1/account/history` + local SHA-256 cross-reference). Fetches the account's chronological anchor ledger, aggregates Bitcoin block settlements, VDF `T_index` ticks, and Corporate Hardware Passkey (`signer_public_key`) signatures, verifies a local file or entire folder bit-for-bit against the ledger (`verify_local_path`), and spins up a self-contained interactive HTML Forensic Audit Report (`reltime-audit-report-*.html`) in the user's browser.

export_csv.description: If true, also exports the audit ledger to a `.csv` spreadsheet file.

limit.description: Maximum number of audit ledger entries to retrieve (default 100, max 500).

mode_filter.description: Filter ledger entries by mode: 'all' (default), 'standard', 'temporal' (VDF T_index), or 'biometric' (Hardware Passkey attested).

open_in_browser.description: If true (default), automatically opens the generated HTML Audit Trail dashboard in the user's browser.

output_dir.description: Optional directory where the generated `.html` / `.csv` audit reports should be saved (defaults to `verify_local_path` folder or `~/.reltime/audits`).

save_html_report.description: If true (default), saves an interactive dark-mode HTML Superhighway Audit Trail dashboard (`reltime-audit-report-<date>.html`).

signer_filter.description: Optional full or partial Hardware Passkey `public_key_hex` to filter anchors signed by a specific employee or corporate YubiKey.

status_filter.description: Filter ledger entries by settlement status: 'all' (default), 'settled', or 'pending'.

verify_local_path.description: Optional local file path or folder/directory path to audit bit-for-bit (Zero-Knowledge local SHA-256 + Passkey attestation check + Stamped Copy check) against the Rel-Time Bitcoin ledger.

name: reltime_audit_trail
